description: This file defines the class 'CategoryServices' which provides various static methods related to product category operations in an e-commerce or product management system. The methods include retrieving category members, navigating to previous and next products within a category, obtaining limited category members, and building category trees. It interacts heavily with the Apache OFBiz framework's entity engine to query and manipulate product and category data.

classes.name: CategoryServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage and retrieve product category related data within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCategoryMembers
methods.description: Retrieves members of a specified product category, returning the category entity and its member list.

methods.name: getPreviousNextProducts
methods.description: Finds the previous and next product IDs relative to a given product within a category, considering optional date and activity filters.

methods.name: getCategoryFindEntityName
methods.description: Determines the appropriate entity name to query based on ordering fields and date limits.

methods.name: getProductCategoryAndLimitedMembers
methods.description: Fetches a product category along with a limited list of its members, supporting pagination, filtering, and stock status considerations.

methods.name: getChildCategoryTree
methods.description: Builds a tree structure of child categories or catalogs for display, based on request parameters.
